race.description: Bendigo Cup Packages On Sale Now Hcp (Bm62)
race.comment: WHAT A RIPPER (12) is a progressive 3yo who won easily at Ballarat Synthetic on debut before a sound effort onto turf at Ballarat last time when third. Up to 1400m now is interesting but his dam did place in a 2000m G1 Australasian Oaks and he gets every chance on the map. CELESTIAL AWARD (9) resumes for her second campaign. She was close up on debut over this trip at Pakenham in a handy maiden and was thought highly enough of to tackle a G1 Vinery at Rosehill before a break. Respecting. REGAL MIGHT (3) is going okay without winning. He's rock hard fit and will be up on speed. VIVA MAURICIO (11) wasn't far away last time at Sandown Lakeside and has been let up since. He can improve.
